Inline stored procedures for hybrid tables (Aug 3, public preview): the whole procedure body executes as one atomic unit pushed to the query-processing layer, cutting per-statement round-trip overhead for OLTP-style calls.
Cortex Analyst → Cortex Agents transition recommended (Aug 28).

JDBC 4.3.4 (Sep 3): pulls Netty fixes for CVE-2026-50020 (request smuggling) and CVE-2026-50010 (TLS hostname-verification bypass), fixes an SQL-injection bug in `DatabaseMetaData.getTablePrivileges()` from unescaped identifiers, restricts WORKLOAD_IDENTITY auth to recognized Snowflake hosts, tightens PrivateLink hostname validation. Behavior change: DECFLOAT `getString()` now returns normalized scientific notation.

Python connector 4.7.3 (Sep 3): same WORKLOAD_IDENTITY host restriction, secret masking on by default across connector and third-party loggers (OAuth/refresh tokens, OTPs), SQL text masked in DEBUG logs, OCSP cache fix in forked processes.
